name: Crimson Horror
storyline:
In this haunted land, an evil sorcerer named the Witch King has risen in the east, raising a tower from the waves off the coast of the city of Dunmere. He has spread a plague among the people, using poisonous, enchanted grain to transform them into hellish monstrosities. After a brief siege, Dunmere has fallen and his minions have spread through the land.

You are the Wanderer, an adventurer of great renown … you have been summoned by the defiant ruler of this land, King Ipslor, to help defeat this evil and save his people. He has journeyed on ahead, leaving you recorded messages (“Chronicles”) every step of the way to warn you of potential dangers and to light your way.

Do you have what it takes to save this land and banish the Witch King? Play on … Crimson Horror awaits.
summary: Crimson Horror is an 8 map MBF21 compatible mapset for Doom 2, featuring extensive use of DEHACKED to add multiple custom weapons and enemies.
